title: INTEL CORP 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Intel Corporation filed an 8-K on April 24, 2026, disclosing the resignation of Scott Gawel as Corporate Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer, effective immediately, to pursue another career opportunity. David A. Zinsner, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, assumed the principal accounting officer role in addition to his existing duties as principal financial officer.
key_points: Scott Gawel resigned as Corporate Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer effective April 24, 2026.
Gawel's resignation was to pursue another career opportunity.
David A. Zinsner, Executive Vice President and CFO, assumed principal accounting officer responsibilities in addition to his existing CFO duties.
This is an Item 5.02 disclosure under SEC regulations, covering departure of certain officers.
